paragraphs.text: 1. HERE is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and he therewith united.
paragraphs.original: इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व ।
paragraphs.translit: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva |

paragraphs.text: Uniting with a body be thou welcome, dear to the Gods in their sublimest birthplace.
paragraphs.original: संवेशने तन्वश्चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे
paragraphs.translit: saṃveśane tanvaścāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre

paragraphs.text: 2. Bearing thy body, Vajin, may thy body afford us blessing and thyself protection.
paragraphs.original: तनूष्टे वाजिन्तन्वं नयन्ती वाममस्मभ्यं धातु शर्म तुभ्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tanūṣṭe vājintanvaṃ nayantī vāmamasmabhyaṃ dhātu śarma tubhyam |

paragraphs.text: Unswerving, stablish as it were in heaven thine own light as the mighty God's supporter.
paragraphs.original: अह्रुतो महो धरुणाय देवान्दिवीव ज्योतिः स्वमा मिमीयाः
paragraphs.translit: ahruto maho dharuṇāya devāndivīva jyotiḥ svamā mimīyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Strong Steed art thou: go to the yearning Maidens with vigour, happily go to heaven and praises:
paragraphs.original: वाज्यसि वाजिनेना सुवेनीः सुवित स्तोमं सुवितो दिवं गाः ।
paragraphs.translit: vājyasi vājinenā suvenīḥ suvita stomaṃ suvito divaṃ gāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Fly happily to the Gods with easy passage, according to the first and faithful statutes.
paragraphs.original: सुवितो धर्म प्रथमानु सत्या सुवितो देवान्सुवितोऽनु पत्म
paragraphs.translit: suvito dharma prathamānu satyā suvito devānsuvito'nu patma

paragraphs.text: 4. Part of their grandeur have the Fathers also gained: the Gods have seated mental power in them as Gods.
paragraphs.original: महिम्न एषां पितरश्चनेशिरे देवा देवेष्वदधुरपि क्रतुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mahimna eṣāṃ pitaraścaneśire devā deveṣvadadhurapi kratum |

paragraphs.text: They have embraced within themselves all energies, which, issuing forth, again into their bodies pass.
paragraphs.original: समविव्यचुरुत यान्यत्विषुरैषां तनूषु नि विविशुः पुनः
paragraphs.translit: samavivyacuruta yānyatviṣuraiṣāṃ tanūṣu ni viviśuḥ punaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. They strode through all the region with victorious might, establishing the old immeasurable laws.
paragraphs.original: सहोभिर्विश्वं परि चक्रमू रजः पूर्वा धामान्यमिता मिमानाः ।
paragraphs.translit: sahobhirviśvaṃ pari cakramū rajaḥ pūrvā dhāmānyamitā mimānāḥ |

paragraphs.text: They compassed in their bodies all existing things, and streamed forth offspring in many successive forms.
paragraphs.original: तनूषु विश्वा भुवना नि येमिरे प्रासारयन्त पुरुध प्रजा अनु
paragraphs.translit: tanūṣu viśvā bhuvanā ni yemire prāsārayanta purudha prajā anu

paragraphs.text: 6. In two ways have the sons established in his place the Asura who finds the light, by the third act,
As fathers, they have set their heritage on earth, their offspring, as a thread continuously spun out.
paragraphs.original: स्वां प्रजां पितरः पित्र्यं सह आवरेष्वदधुस्तन्तुमाततम्
paragraphs.translit: svāṃ prajāṃ pitaraḥ pitryaṃ saha āvareṣvadadhustantumātatam

paragraphs.text: 7. As in a ship through billows, so through regions of air, with blessings, through toils and troubles
paragraphs.original: नावा न क्षोदः प्रदिशः पृथिव्याः स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा ।
paragraphs.translit: nāvā na kṣodaḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyāḥ svastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā |

paragraphs.text: Hath Brhaduktha brought his seed with glory, and placed it here and in the realms beyond us.
